import struct, csv
from datetime import date, timedelta

data = open('/app/inventory.bin','rb').read()
assert data[:4] == b'BIN2'
n = struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
off = 6
rows = []
for _ in range(n):
    rid = struct.unpack('>I', data[off:off+4])[0]; off += 4
    ln = data[off]; off += 1
    name = data[off:off+ln].decode('ascii'); off += ln
    price = struct.unpack('>f', data[off:off+4])[0]; off += 4
    qty = struct.unpack('>I', data[off:off+4])[0]; off += 4
    days = struct.unpack('>H', data[off:off+2])[0]; off += 2
    d = date(2020,1,1) + timedelta(days=days)
    rows.append((rid, name, f"{price:.2f}", qty, d.isoformat()))

rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
with open('/app/inventory.csv','w',newline='') as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['id','name','price','quantity','date'])
    w.writerows(rows)
print(open('/app/inventory.csv').read())
